steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Control board and inlet valve are not grounded during service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Execute service after unplugging the power supply unit.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Smart Install entered. Continue with component checks below.

steps.title: Vent and lint screen
steps.body: Clean lint screen. Verify vent not restricted — tC/tC5 often vent-related.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Clean lint screen. Verify vent not restricted — tC/tC5 often vent-related.

steps.title: Measure thermistor resistance
steps.body: Disconnect power. Measure thermistor1 and thermistor2 per §4-6 — compare both; manual directs resistance check when code present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Measure thermistor1 and thermistor2 per §4-6 — compare both; manual directs resistance check when code present.

steps.title: Thermistor readings plausible?
steps.body: Both thermistors show similar reasonable resistance (not open/shorted vs each other)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Both thermistors show similar reasonable resistance (not open/shorted vs each other)?

steps.title: Replace thermistor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace faulty thermistor and verify vent path.

steps.title: Thermistors OK
steps.oemOutcome: Thermistors in range — suspect PCB if tC/HC persists.
